candidates.title: claimYieldFeeShares zeroes the entire yieldFeeBalance on a partial claim
candidates.description: claimYieldFeeShares(_shares) caches _yieldFeeBalance = yieldFeeBalance, validates _shares <= _yieldFeeBalance, then executes `yieldFeeBalance -= _yieldFeeBalance` (subtracting the full cached balance) while minting only `_shares`. On any claim where _shares < yieldFeeBalance the recipient forfeits the unclaimed remainder, which is permanently zeroed without shares being minted for it.

candidates.title: claimYieldFeeShares zeroes the full yieldFeeBalance on a partial claim
candidates.description: claimYieldFeeShares caches _yieldFeeBalance then executes `yieldFeeBalance -= _yieldFeeBalance` (full balance) while minting only `_shares`. A partial claim (_shares < balance) destroys the unclaimed remainder.

candidates.title: Malicious/reverting winner prize hook griefs the claimer and blocks the prize claim
candidates.description: claimPrize calls a winner-controlled hook (beforeClaimPrize/afterClaimPrize) set via the permissionless, unvalidated HookManager.setHooks. Although the call is gas-capped at HOOK_GAS (150k), a hook that reverts (or forces an OOG that bubbles) reverts the entire claimPrize, so the claimer expends gas with no reward and the prize cannot be claimed for that winner.

candidates.title: Reverting/gas-griefing winner hook blocks the prize claim and griefs the claimer
candidates.description: claimPrize invokes a winner-controlled hook (set via permissionless setHooks) capped at HOOK_GAS. A hook that reverts (or causes an OOG that propagates) reverts the whole claim, denying the claimer's reward and stranding the winner's prize.

candidates.title: Lossy-state withdrawals round down against depositors once the yield buffer is depleted
candidates.description: convertToAssets/previewWithdraw use mulDiv rounding DOWN of (totalAssets,totalDebt) when totalAssets < totalDebt. The no-loss guarantee only holds while the yield buffer covers the 1-wei rounding; once depleted, withdrawers lose dust and the loss can be ground down by repeated small withdrawals.

candidates.title: setHooks is permissionless and the hook implementation is unvalidated
candidates.description: Any account can set an arbitrary hook implementation; combined with the gas-capped external call in claimPrize this enables the claimer-griefing DoS (see DOS-01). By design but the unvalidated external call is the root enabler.

candidates.title: Liquidation fee rounding asymmetry can revert a max liquidation
candidates.description: liquidatableBalanceOf rounds the liquid yield DOWN via mulDiv(FEE_PRECISION-fee,FEE_PRECISION); transferTokensOut re-derives the fee with amountOut*FEE_PRECISION/(FEE_PRECISION-fee)-amountOut and enforces a strict revert. The roundings are inconsistent so quoting exactly the advertised max can revert.

candidates.title: Liquidation rounding asymmetry may revert a max liquidation quoted by liquidatableBalanceOf
candidates.description: liquidatableBalanceOf rounds the liquid yield DOWN using (FEE_PRECISION - fee)/FEE_PRECISION, while transferTokensOut re-derives the fee with a different formula (amountOut*FEE_PRECISION/(FEE_PRECISION-fee) - amountOut) and enforces a strict `amountOut + yieldFee > availableYield` revert. The two roundings are not mutually consistent, so a liquidation pair quoting exactly the advertised liquidatable balance can revert by ~1 wei.

candidates.title: Direct asset donation inflates totalAssets / availableYield
candidates.description: totalAssets() includes _asset.balanceOf(this) (latent balance). A direct token donation increases availableYield and can be liquidated to the prize pool; combined with the dust-collection strategy, donation timing around liquidations may be gameable. Yield buffer + 1:1 mint mitigate the classic first-depositor inflation.

candidates.title: maxRedeem/maxWithdraw may over-report relative to the yield vault's instantaneous redemption limit
candidates.description: maxWithdraw/maxRedeem derive from _maxYieldVaultWithdraw()=convertToAssets(maxRedeem) of the yield vault plus latent balance; if the underlying yield vault's withdraw path imposes tighter limits than redeem, a withdraw at the reported max can revert.

candidates.title: No reentrancy guard on the claim path; winner hook can re-enter the vault
candidates.description: claimPrize calls beforeClaimPrize/afterClaimPrize (attacker contracts) with no nonReentrant guard. A winner hook can re-enter deposit/withdraw/transfer/setHooks during the claim. Impact depends on PrizePool semantics; flagged for trace.

candidates.title: _withdraw uses raw _asset.transfer instead of SafeERC20.safeTransfer
candidates.description: Line 939 calls `_asset.transfer(_receiver,_assets)` without checking the return value, while the rest of the contract uses SafeERC20. Non-standard ERC20s (e.g. USDT) that return no bool or return false silently can cause a silent failure / inconsistency.

candidates.title: Fee-on-transfer / rebasing assets break deposit accounting
candidates.description: _depositAndMint mints shares 1:1 to _assets while assuming the full _assets arrived; a fee-on-transfer asset delivers less, leaving totalAssets<totalDebt. The vault documents non-support but does not enforce it.
